--- a/src/tasks.nim
+++ b/src/tasks.nim
+proc csvFieldNeedsQuote*(s: string): bool =
+  for c in s:
+    if c in {',', '"', '\n', '\r'}:
+      return true
+  false
+proc csvQuote*(s: string): string =
+  if not csvFieldNeedsQuote(s):
+    return s
+  result = "\""
+  for c in s:
+    if c == '"': result.add("\"\"")
+    else: result.add(c)
+  result.add('"')
+proc formatCsv*(tasks: openArray[Task]): string =
+  var lines: seq[string] = @["id,title"]
+  for t in tasks:
+    lines.add($t.id & "," & csvQuote(t.title))
+  lines.join("\n")

  "target_file": "src/demo_tasks.nim",

  "edits": [
    {
      "oldText": "## Minimal tasks CLI — default: list tasks.
import std/[os, strutils]
import ./tasks

proc main() =
  let args = commandLineParams()
  let cmd = if args.len > 0: args[0] else: "list"
  case cmd
  of "list", "":
    echo formatList(loadTasks())
  else:
    stderr.writeLine("unknown command: " & cmd)
    stderr.writeLine("usage: demo_tasks [list]")
    quit(2)

when isMainModule:
  main()
",
      "newText": "## Minimal tasks CLI — default: list tasks; opt-in CSV export.
import std/[os, strutils]
import ./tasks

proc main() =
  let args = commandLineParams()
  let cmd = if args.len > 0: args[0] else: "list"
  case cmd
  of "list", "":
    echo formatList(loadTasks())
  of "export-csv":
    echo formatCsv(loadTasks())
  else:
    stderr.writeLine("unknown command: " & cmd)
    stderr.writeLine("usage: demo_tasks [list|export-csv]")
    quit(2)

when isMainModule:
  main()
